name: Grizzelda
bio: Brews potions, curses rivals and keeps exact count of both.
notes: Downloaded by hand (owner, 2026-10-29) as an unrigged textured GLB; rigged by Meshy's rigging API (source.modelUrl "upload": the download, cut to 200k triangles, sent as a data URI; the task in source.meshy.rig). Queue note: lady goblin. Was held back: hunched, with clawed hands and a cape; the found hands tore.
